visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two people in school uniforms (white shirts, black skirt/pants) perform a synchronized dance involving pointing and hip sways. The female has a red bow and the male a black tie. Behind them is a green chalkboard with drawings and 'Hello' written on it. The lighting is bright indoor studio light. (2) The scene cuts to a studio hallway where three people, led by a man in a grey button-up shirt, dance enthusiastically with their hands on their hips. There are posters on the wall and a sign saying 'Hi there'. The lighting is warm and professional. (3) Transition to an outdoor paved walkway with trees and benches. The lead man in a grey vest and a woman in a white sleeveless dress dance with large, rhythmic arm movements and joyful facial expressions. (4) In a sunny park, the lead man and a woman in a pink sundress dance; she holds a small white plush toy while smiling broadly. The ground has a circular stone pattern. (5) A series of fast-paced montage cuts alternates between the classroom, the hallway, the street, and a school courtyard, showing various male-male and male-female pairings performing the same choreographed 'weird' moves. (6) The final scene returns to the park where the man and the woman in pink are seen in a medium shot, laughing and interacting casually. The woman hides her face behind the plush toy while the man gestures toward her.
